# STRATHEX Audit — Final Report

<!-- Generated by an automated multi-agent audit (25 agents: 12 finders, 12 adversarial verifiers, 1 synthesis). Findings were fact-checked against source; REFUTED items dropped. -->

_126 verified findings. Line numbers reflect the audited snapshot and may drift as fixes land._


Synthesized from all surviving CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE findings. Overlapping reports merged; ranked severity × confidence within each section. Every item cites real code.

**Coverage note:** This report covers the live handicap path (`calculator.py`→strathmark adapter), the STRATHEX display/sim path (`prediction_aggregator`), the Excel I/O layer, and the UI/tournament modules. It does **not** cover strathmark internals (out of repo) — several `size_mm`/`diameter` NaN findings are confirmed *at the boundary* but their downstream blast radius inside strathmark is inferred, not proven.

---

## 1. Correctness bugs

### High

**Results-sheet column schema drift — three incompatible schemas write into one sheet** — `excel_io.py:374-385, 662-693` + `handicap_ui.py:504-566` — **[CONFIRMED]**
The live workbook header is 7 columns (`…Species Code, Date (optional), Notes`). `append_results_to_excel` (excel_io) appends 8 positional values, so `round_name` pollutes the free-text Notes column and `heat_id` lands in an unnamed 8th column. Worse, `detect_results_sheet`'s *auto-create* path writes a **different** 8-col order (`…Species Code, Quality, HeatID, Date`); on that path `load_results_df` maps `heat_id`→date→**NaT** and `timestamp`→quality→**NaN** — the exact NaT/NaN class recently patched. A third divergent writer lives in `handicap_ui.py`. **Fix:** define the Results column list once in `excel_io`; have every writer/​header-builder derive from it in identical order matching the real file; migrate or explicitly schema the Round/HeatID columns.

**Championship events are never marked `ready` / never given marks → whole tournament blocks** — `multi_event_ui.py:641-649, 1811-1821` — **[CONFIRMED]**
The championship branch hits `continue` with a comment "marks pre-assigned," but nothing pre-assigns them. Events reach `generate_complete_day_schedule` with `status='configured'` and empty `handicap_results_all`; line 1812 rejects everything not `ready`, so schedule generation is blocked and displays render marks as `?`. **Fix:** before the `continue`, populate `handicap_results_all` with a Mark-3 record per competitor and set `status='ready'`, mirroring `tournament_ui.py:680-693`.

**`render_match_box_compact` crashes (TypeError) on any TBD match** — `bracket_ui.py:1458-1472` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Match dicts set `competitor1/2` explicitly to `None`, so `.get(…, "TBD")` returns `None` (key present), and `c1_display[:28]` slices `None`. Reached by the double-elim bracket view (choice 2) on the first empty R2+ match → the whole view is unusable. **Fix:** `comp1 = match.get("competitor1") or "TBD"` (and comp2) before slicing.

**Personal Best Watch reads non-existent Title-Case columns → KeyError** — `championship_simulator.py:1188-1191` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`load_results_df` returns snake_case (`competitor_name`, `event`, `raw_time`); this path indexes `["Competitor"]`, `["Event"]`, `["Time (seconds)"]`. Any non-empty results set aborts the display. **Fix:** use the normalized names (sibling `_display_cross_wood_transferability` already does).

**UnboundLocalError in Tournament Finances (menu option 5)** — `MainProgramV5_2.py:1657-1663` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`choice` is assigned only in the option 2/3/4 branches; option 5 calls `display_actionable_error(...)` without capturing the return, then reads `choice` at 1663. Selecting 5 before any tournament exists crashes the app (or branches on stale `choice`). **Fix:** `choice = display_actionable_error(...)`. (`quick_action_key="1"` is already present — no other change needed.)

**Numeric selection prompts accept 0 / negatives → negative indexing selects the wrong item** — `v52_helpers.py:154-155, 167-168, 220-221, 237-238, 305-306, 318-319, 394-395` + `MainProgramV5_2.py:1276-1277` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`idx = int(input()) - 1` then indexes a list inside `except (ValueError, IndexError)`. Entering `0`→`-1` returns the **last** element (no IndexError); any small negative returns a valid wrong element. Real consequence: scratching/removing the wrong competitor, or recording results against the wrong heat. The guarded pattern at `MainProgramV5_2.py:430` shows the intended design. **Fix:** add `if not (0 <= idx < len(seq)): continue` before each index.

### Medium

**Event payouts show $0.00 after a save/load round-trip (int vs str dict keys)** — `multi_event_ui.py:2416, 2429` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Payouts are built with integer position keys; JSON stringifies them on save and `load_multi_event_tournament` never coerces back, so `payouts.get(position, 0)` (int key) misses and returns 0. Triggered by a normal resume. **Fix:** coerce `payout_config['payouts']` keys to int on load.

**Scratching a competitor leaves stale copies → withdrawn competitor reappears in heats** — `scratch_management.py:235-258` — **[CONFIRMED]**
The handler edits `all_competitors` and pending-round lists but never touches `event['handicap_results_all']` or `all_competitors_df`; `generate_complete_day_schedule` re-reads those and re-introduces the scratched competitor. **Fix:** filter `handicap_results_all`, `all_competitors_df`, and each pending round's `competitors_df` in sync.

**Entry-fee events matched by name instead of `event_id`** — `entry_fee_tracker.py:54-61, 166-169, 219-228` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Auto-generated `event_name` (`"300mm SB"`) is non-unique; marking resolves via first name match, so two same-named events collapse and the second stays unpaid / wrong event credited. **Fix:** key unpaid structures by `event_id`, use names for display only.

**New `CompetitorID` derived from `ws.max_row` collides after an Excel row deletion** — `personnel_ui.py:137` — **[CONFIRMED]**
The menu tells judges to delete competitors directly in Excel; after a deletion `max_row` no longer tracks the max suffix, so the next add reuses an existing ID → id↔name corruption in results. **Fix:** scan column A for numeric suffixes and use `max(existing)+1`.

**Manual-entry date stored raw, no validation** — `history_entry.py:104-108` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`if date_input: timestamp = date_input` persists the user string verbatim; the sibling `personnel_ui` path validates with `strptime('%Y-%m-%d')`. Malformed → NaT downstream (now handled), but ambiguous-but-parseable strings persist as wrong dates. **Fix:** validate with `strptime`, fall back to `now().isoformat()`; extract a shared date-parse helper for both entry paths.

**`None` baseline time crashes prediction-analysis formatting** — `prediction_aggregator.py:620-632` (also `498-509, 553-557`) — **[CONFIRMED]**
`predict_baseline_v2_hybrid` can return `time=None`; the summary builder guards `if ml and llm:` (not baseline) then formats `f"…Baseline={baseline:.1f}s…"` → TypeError, unguarded in `display_dual_predictions`. Fires for any species/diameter with zero history. **Fix:** `base_str = f'{baseline:.1f}s' if baseline is not None else 'N/A'` in both summary builders.

**`recency_score` leaks NaN into ML features on degenerate datasets** — `preprocessing.py:275-283` — **[CONFIRMED]**
When every `(competitor,event)` group has one row, `diff()` is all-NaT → `median()` is NaN → `fillna(NaN)`/`clip` preserve NaN. The no-date branch uses a concrete `365.0`; this branch doesn't. **Fix:** fall back to `365.0` when the median is NaN, before clip.

**`Series.get()` lets NaN wood properties into the live feature vector** — `ml_model.py:483-488` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`wood_row.iloc[0].get('janka_hard', 500)` returns a stored **NaN** (default only applies when the label is absent); `float(NaN)` then poisons `wood_janka_hardness` and `quality_x_hardness`. Live path via `predict_time_ml`. **Fix:** `pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce')` + `np.isfinite` fallback for all six wood lookups.

**`append_results_to_excel` can mint a partial Results-only workbook on load failure** — `excel_io.py:662-693` — **[CONFIRMED]**
On a `load_workbook` exception it builds a bare `Workbook()`, adds only a Results sheet, and saves over the path — a Wood/Competitor-less stub that shadows all later species/roster lookups (same class as the just-fixed read-path stub). **Fix:** call `ensure_workbook(paths.EXCEL_FILE)` before load; never overwrite an existing path with a freshly-minted bare workbook — re-raise/abort.

### Low (confirmed unless noted)

- **`size_mm` NaN unguarded crossing into strathmark** — `strathmark_adapter.py:94` — `float(row.get('size_mm',300))` returns a stored NaN (not the default); `raw_time`/`quality`/`date` are all guarded, `size_mm` isn't. **Fix:** `if pd.isna(size_mm): size_mm = 300.0`.
- **Bye placement mis-seeds non-power-of-2 brackets** — `bracket_ui.py:158-185, 264-278` — two bye seeds both feed the same R2 slot, forcing seeds 1 & 2 to meet in the semifinal. **Fix:** interleave byes into standard bracket slot positions.
- **`render_tree_recursive` never recurses** — `bracket_ui.py:1520-1561` — the "full bracket tree" prints only Round 1 (function never advances `round_idx` or calls itself). **Fix:** iterate all rounds / implement the recursion.
- **Truthiness treats a 0.0-second prediction as missing** — `prediction_aggregator.py:502,515,518,624,746,751,756` + `check_my_work.py` — `if ml and llm:` drops a legit `0.0`. **Fix:** use explicit `is not None`.
- **`competitor_experience` cumcount computed before the chronological sort** — `preprocessing.py:174 vs 278` — correct only when the sheet is already date-ordered. **Fix:** sort before `cumcount`.
- **Wood quality `0` silently clamped to `1`** — `wood_ui.py:186-199` — clamp + prompt + error text + `MainProgram:210` doc give three different ranges. **Fix:** pick one authoritative range; reject or accept 0 explicitly instead of silent clamp.
- **Assignment message reports `len(selected_events)` not `len(final_events)`** — `multi_event_ui.py:1744` — overstates events assigned when some were blocked for insufficient history. **Fix:** print `len(final_events)`.
- **`schedule_printout` box borders misalign >68 chars; results assumed numeric** — `schedule_printout.py:78-85, 194-210` — `.ljust(68)` never truncates; `{actual_time:.1f}` raises on a non-numeric stored result. **Fix:** truncate to width; format only `isinstance(actual_time,(int,float))`.
- **`generate_bracket_seeds` sorts predicted_time with no NaN hygiene** — `bracket_ui.py:566-583` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — a NaN time (candidate filter is `is not None`) yields nondeterministic seeds. **Fix:** map NaN→`inf` before sorting.
- **Inverted NaN guard** — `baseline.py:425,434-435` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — `time_val <= 0` doesn't reject NaN, unlike siblings; upstream `validate_results_data` protects the main path, so latent. **Fix:** add `pd.isna` to match siblings.
- **`json.dump(default=str)` diverges from `NumpyEncoder`** — `tournament_ui.py:914-927` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — no int64 column reproduces today; consistency risk. **Fix:** reuse the existing `NumpyEncoder`.
- **Type hint uses builtin `any`** — `history_entry.py:75` — `Dict[str, any]`. **Fix:** `typing.Any`.

*(The LightGBM/RandomForest/Ridge prediction defects — species ignored, stale interaction features, unsorted `iloc[-1]`, raw un-uppercased event key, object-dtype template — are all CONFIRMED as logic bugs but sit entirely in unreachable modules; see §3. Deleting those modules resolves them.)*

## 2. Stability & error-handling

### Medium

**Module-level hardness/exponent caches never invalidated → stale after data reload** — `baseline.py:170-171, 227-230, 242-244, 1780-1785` (+ `diameter_scaling.py:31,275`) — **[CONFIRMED]**
`_wood_hardness_cache` (built once), `_species_exponent_cache` (keyed only on event_code), and `_event_exponent_cache` freeze to the first data seen. `invalidate_baseline_v2_cache` resets only `_baseline_v2_cache`, so the tournament app (reloads from Excel) and tests (invalidate between datasets) get stale calibration / cross-test contamination. **Fix:** have `invalidate_baseline_v2_cache` clear all three (and expose a reset for `diameter_scaling`), or key on a data fingerprint. *(Note: the ML/XGBoost cache is NOT affected — it keys on row count; `Baseline-V2 model cache goes stale mid-session` at `baseline.py:1737-1740` is the same root issue, downgraded to low there.)*

**Broad `except Exception` silently downgrades V2 baseline to V1** — `prediction_aggregator.py:165-166` (mirrored `ai_predictor.py:104`) — **[CONFIRMED]**
The whole `predict_baseline_v2_hybrid` call is wrapped and falls into a ~100-line V1 reimplementation with no logging. Any V2 dtype/NaN/KeyError defect is invisible and every competitor silently uses the inferior path — exactly the silent-fallback class that hid the earlier NaT/stub bugs. **Fix:** catch narrowly or at minimum log (competitor name + exception) before falling back.

**Tournament-state save fails silently when `saves/` is missing** — `tournament_ui.py:901-932` (also `multi_event_ui.py:190-216`) — **[CONFIRMED]**
`open('saves/…')` inside `except Exception: print(...)`, no `os.makedirs` anywhere in the repo, `saves/` gitignored → a clean checkout loses every auto-save with one scrolled-off line. `NumpyEncoder` also misses `np.bool_`/`Timestamp`. **Fix:** `os.makedirs(dirname, exist_ok=True)` before open; write-temp-then-`os.replace` for atomicity; extend the encoder; surface failures loudly.

**`input()` and a second LLM analysis pass inside a display function** — `prediction_aggregator.py:1231-1244` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`display_dual_predictions` blocks on `input()` then calls `generate_prediction_analysis_llm`; `display_comprehensive_prediction_analysis:986` regenerates the same expensive Ollama analysis. Not reusable headlessly (tests/adapter/batch hang). **Fix:** move `input()` to the UI layer; compute the analysis once and pass it into both display paths.

### Low

- **`pd.ExcelFile` handle in `_resolve_sheet_name` never closed** — `excel_io.py:42-49` — no context manager/`close()`; on Windows keeps `woodchopping.xlsx` locked until GC. Refcount collection makes a hard save-lock unlikely but the leak is real and hit on every load. **Fix:** `with pd.ExcelFile(excel_path) as xl:`.
- **Workbook left open on save failure** — `excel_io.py:423-433, 674-693` — `wb.close()` only on the success path. **Fix:** close in `finally`.
- **`ResultStore` dual-write wrapped in `except Exception: pass`** — `excel_io.py:696-731` — store persistence (which feeds future predictions) can fail with zero diagnostics; a redundant inner per-record swallow too. **Fix:** log instead of pass; drop the inner swallow.
- **Silent `except Exception: pass` hides LLM parse failures** — `ai_predictor.py:471-473` — comment says "Log" but nothing logs. **Fix:** log the exception + response snippet.
- **`_species_cache` permanently caches fallback/negative lookups** — `excel_io.py:243, 249` — a transient read error pins the raw code as the "name" for the whole session. **Fix:** cache only successful resolutions.
- **`select_best_prediction` returns a `0.0` sentinel** — `prediction_aggregator.py:441-442` — downstream treats `0.0` as a real time in `mark + predicted_time` while tables render it as N/A. **Fix:** return `None`; callers treat as missing.
- **Win-rate bar chart divides by max win% without guarding zero/empty** — `visualization.py:127-132` — `ZeroDivisionError`/`ValueError` on empty/all-zero distribution. **Fix:** `max(values, default=0)` and `max_pct or 1`.
- **Restore re-adds competitor without status checks; can't restore heats** — `scratch_management.py:379-401, 271-275` — re-injects into completed/in-progress events, leaves `competitors_df`/`handicap_results_all` out of sync. **Fix:** guard on `event['status']`; keep structures in sync.
- **`event['event_name']` direct index risks KeyError** — `tournament_status.py:158` — sibling elif uses `.get`. **Fix:** `event.get('event_name', 'Unknown Event')`.
- **HTML export injects names unescaped, writes silently to cwd, no try/except** — `bracket_ui.py:1601-1637, 1962-1968` — `<`/`>`/`&` break markup; OSError propagates uncaught. **Fix:** `html.escape()` + guarded write to a defined path.
- **Manual advancer selection can loop forever if `num_to_advance` > pool** — `tournament_ui.py:372-393` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — no break when the pool is exhausted. **Fix:** clamp to `min(num_to_advance, len(available))`.
- **Bracket sim awards win to `name_a` on missing stats** — `championship_simulator.py:1471-1472` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — inconsistent with the fair-coin fallback at 1609-1613. **Fix:** match the fair fallback.
- **Species list numbering relies on index==iloc position** — `wood_ui.py:95-106` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — latent desync if any future `reset_index` is skipped. **Fix:** `enumerate(...)` for display numbering.
- **Corrupted box glyphs / no-op `.replace()`** — `bracket_ui.py:1244-1317` (active match renders as `?` rows), plus mojibake `??`/`?`*70 at `schedule_printout.py:142-143` and `bracket_ui.py:1264,1516,1570-1572`, and broken frame corners in `payout_ui.py:52-56,434-438` / `entry_fee_tracker.py:67-101`. **Fix:** restore real glyphs; delete self-referential replaces.
- **Import-time `subprocess chcp` with bare except** — `MainProgramV5_2.py:16-24` — spawns a shell every startup, swallows all failures. **Fix:** rely on `sys.stdout.reconfigure`; log not pass; move into `main()`.

## 3. Dead / superseded code

**Seven orphaned prediction modules (~1,900–2,000 lines)** — `predictions/{production, stacking_ensemble, lightgbm_model, randomforest_model, ridge_model, calibration, diameter_diagnostic}.py` — **[CONFIRMED]** — **highest-value cleanup**
Repo-wide grep confirms a dead dependency island: `production.py` has no importers; `stacking_ensemble` is imported only by `production`; the three base models only by `stacking_ensemble`; `calibration` and `diameter_diagnostic` by nobody. The live handicap path (`calculator.py`→strathmark) and the live display/sim path (`prediction_aggregator.get_all_predictions`) never reach any of them; only tests do. Because they're never imported they add **no runtime risk** — this is maintenance surface + reader confusion, and it's where the many CONFIRMED-but-dead model bugs live (StackingEnsemble is an unimplemented placeholder that still trains and discards an XGBoost model; RandomForest computes sample weights then never passes them; species ignored / stale interactions / `iloc[-1]` / raw event key across all three; blanket `except` in `_get_base_predictions`; ABTester's process-randomized `hash()`). **Fix:** delete the seven modules plus their dedicated tests (`tests/validation/test_model_comparison.py`), or move them to an `experimental/` area outside the import graph. Verify strathmark doesn't re-import them (it doesn't — STRATHEX-internal).

**`_display_race_analysis` is a no-op stub; `get_championship_race_analysis` orphaned** — `championship_simulator.py:981-993` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Option 18 forces a full Monte Carlo run then prints only a divider line; the fairness wrapper it should call has zero call sites. **Fix:** wire the stub to `fairness.get_championship_race_analysis`, or remove the option, stub, and wrapper.

**`check_my_work` eagerly imported at startup, never called by the app** — `check_my_work.py` (whole file, 342 lines) — **[CONFIRMED]**
Re-exported via `predictions/__init__.py`; only self-internal + test callers. Reachable via public API, so probably-dead rather than a hard orphan. **Fix:** confirm no menu wiring is intended, then drop from `__init__` and remove module + test. *(Note: its line 143 `[r["predicted_time"] for r in handicap_results]` is a discarded list comprehension — a stray unguarded key access.)*

**`explanation_system_functions.py` — stale, internally contradictory docs (not dead code)** — `368-406 vs 2451-2522; 2496; 2373` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Claims 23 features in one place, 6 in another; cites a non-existent `FunctionsLibrary.py` and an XGBoost engine that no longer exists (calculation now delegates to strathmark). The module *is* imported (`MainProgramV5_2.py:28`), so this is stale-docs, not dead-code. **Fix:** reconcile the counts, drop `FunctionsLibrary.py` references, update prose to the strathmark-delegated engine.

**Assorted dead statements** — all **[CONFIRMED]**, all safe deletes:
- `baseline.py:1216-1220` — `diameter_curves` built (with `lstsq` per event) then overwritten unread at 1309; keep `events` (used at 1343).
- `baseline.py` — V1 path (`predict_baseline_time`/`backtest_baseline_predictions`/`get_competitor_historical_times_flexible`/`diameter_scaling.scale_time_list`) is exported API with no production or test callers.
- `MainProgramV5_2.py:1087` — bare `len(...)`; `tournament_ui.py:50` — bare `//`; `handicap_ui.py:333,420-421` — discarded `quality` + redundant `continue`; `multi_event_ui.py:2414,2421,2423,2425` — four no-op expression statements; `prediction_aggregator.py:408-410` — self-assigning dict copy; `stacking_ensemble.py:225` — bare list comprehension; unused `sklearn` imports across the four model modules.
- `excel_io.py:674-686` — `if ws.max_row == 0:` header-write is **unreachable** (an openpyxl sheet never reports 0; `detect_results_sheet` always appends a header). Delete (also flagged by the schema-drift finding).
- `bracket_ui.py:612-638,813` — `!= "bye"` sub-conditions always true (dead); `final_placements` (838-852) is written but never read anywhere.

## 4. Duplication & cleanliness

**Duplicated V1 baseline fallback across two modules — defaults already drifted** — `prediction_aggregator.py:166-268` vs `ai_predictor.py:110-193` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Near-verbatim tier logic and size-default cascade, but the defaults have **diverged**: aggregator `350→60/300→45/250→35/else 30` vs ai_predictor `350→60/300→50/275→45/else 40`. Bug fixes must be applied twice. **Fix:** extract `_baseline_v1_fallback(...)` parameterized on the default cascade / quality handling.

**Duplicate `append_results_to_excel` writing a divergent, Quality-dropping schema** — `handicap_ui.py:290-575` — **[CONFIRMED]** (see §1 schema drift)
The `handicap_ui` copy writes a different column order and omits the store dual-write; it's exported in `ui/__init__.py __all__`, so `from woodchopping.ui import append_results_to_excel` resolves to the **corrupting** one. Dormant today (live callers import the canonical version). **Fix:** delete the copy, remove from `ui/__init__.py`, make `excel_io` the single writer.

**Other confirmed duplication** (all low, all "centralize into one helper"):
- Janka-proxy fallback comprehension repeated **5×** — `preprocessing.py:455-570` → `_janka_proxy_index(wood_df)`.
- Quality-adjustment factor logic **3×** (one in the dead V1 path), same `0.02` coeff, opposite directions — `baseline.py:338-350, 543-553, 2031-2043` → `quality_multiplier(quality)`.
- Competitor/event mask + valid-row filter copy-pasted — `baseline.py:399-402, 683-686, 764, 877-880, 1102-1104` → `competitor_event_mask()` / `valid_time_mask()`. **This copy-paste is the direct root cause of the §1 NaN-guard divergences.**
- Pairwise-discrepancy computation **3×** with divergent thresholds (`≥4s` vs `>5s`) — `prediction_aggregator.py:694-762`, `check_my_work.py:85-127`, `…:502-519` → one `pairwise_prediction_diffs()`.
- Handicap-table render + status-validation blocks **3×** (already drifted: one has a `Method` column, one doesn't; `1812` uses a different status predicate) — `multi_event_ui.py:787, 1073, 1991` → `print_handicap_table()` / `handicaps_ready()`.
- Match-dict literal hand-written **~7×** + duplicated progress-count loops — `bracket_ui.py:160-511, 1032-1058` → `make_match(...)` factory + `_count_completed()`.
- Payout-within-paid-places summation **3×** (per-competitor variant already differs) — `payout_ui.py:225-229, 273-279, 324-326` → `paid_amount()`.
- `tournament_state` init dict duplicated — `MainProgramV5_2.py:166-178 vs 501-513` → `new_tournament_state()` factory.
- Manual error-box drawing duplicates `display_blocking_error` — `MainProgramV5_2.py:874-896, 1181-1190` (note: helper shares the same emoji-width misalignment; this centralizes maintenance, doesn't fix borders).
- Two near-duplicate roster-selection functions — `competitor_ui.py:21-210 vs 276-358` — **[PLAUSIBLE]**, intentionally different multi- vs single-select semantics; judgment-call refactor.
- Copy-pasted predict scaffolding across the three (dead) base models — resolved by deletion (§3).

## 5. Efficiency

### High

**`mark_results_to_dicts` re-runs full per-competitor predictions (incl. blocking Ollama LLM) purely for display** — `strathmark_adapter.py:184-227` — **[CONFIRMED]**
On the live view-handicaps path, `HandicapCalculator.calculate()` runs first, then this loop calls strathmark `get_all_predictions(..., llm_client={url:…/api/generate, timeout:120})` **again for every competitor** just to rebuild the 3-column display. `model=None` does **not** skip the LLM (strathmark resolves `DEFAULT_MODEL`; only an empty URL skips Ollama), so when Ollama is reachable-but-slow this is N × up-to-120s round-trips per heat. A per-competitor `except` degrades rather than crashes. **Fix:** have `HandicapCalculator.calculate()` surface the per-method predictions it already computed and build the dict from those; at minimum pass `llm_client=None` here so the redisplay never re-hits Ollama.

**`median_diameter` feature is an O(n²) full-DataFrame rescan per row** — `baseline.py:1211-1214` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`results_df.apply(lambda row: get_competitor_median_diameter(row['competitor_name'], row['event'], results_df), axis=1)` rebuilds two string-normalized boolean masks over the entire frame for every row, inside every cold `fit_hierarchical_regression`. **Fix:** `results_df.groupby(['competitor_name','event'])['size_mm'].transform('median').fillna(300.0)` — identical result, O(n), behavior-preserving.

**Full Excel results file re-loaded once per competitor during event assignment** — `multi_event_ui.py:1608, 1659` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`results_df = load_results_df()` sits inside `for comp in roster:`; each call is 2 full workbook parses (results + competitor mapping) → 2N parses. Data doesn't change between competitors. **Fix:** load once before the loop; keep the legitimate reload at line 1700 (after new times are actually appended).

### Medium

**`get_all_predictions` reloads the wood sheet + re-standardizes results on every per-competitor call** — `prediction_aggregator.py:123, 138` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`standardize_results_data` and `load_wood_data()` (a full `pd.read_excel`) run unconditionally; `bracket_ui.py:555` and `championship_simulator.py:335` call it once per competitor. Results_df is threaded in, but wood_df has no cache, so the wood sheet is re-read from disk N times. **Fix:** cache `wood_df` at module level (mirror `_species_cache`), or thread one `wood_df` / pre-standardized frame through the loop.

**`results_df` re-read from Excel on every menu action, plus a redundant in-function import** — `MainProgramV5_2.py:150, 806-808, 912, 1602, 1710` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`comp_df` is cached in a global; `results_df` never is, so every action re-parses the whole workbook. Line 806 also re-imports `load_results_df` already imported at 33-37. **Fix:** cache `results_df` in a module global, invalidate on `append_results_to_excel`; remove the redundant import.

**Repeated full-workbook reads per logical load** — `excel_io.py:253-356` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`load_results_df` → `_resolve_sheet_name` (opens `pd.ExcelFile`) → `pd.read_excel` → `get_competitor_id_name_mapping` (another `_resolve_sheet_name` + `pd.read_excel`) = 4 open/parse ops of the same file per results load. **Fix:** open the workbook once and read needed sheets from it, or memoize with write-path invalidation.

**Workbook reopened + id/name mapping reloaded once per historical time entry** — `personnel_ui.py:238-249` (also `history_entry.py:111-120`) — **[CONFIRMED]**
`save_time_to_results` per time does a full Competitor-sheet read + `load_workbook`/`append`/`save`/`close`; entering N times = 2N reads + N rewrites, widening the partial-write window. **Fix:** add a batched `save_times_to_results` that opens once, resolves the mapping once, appends all rows, saves once.

**`load_wood_data()` re-read twice per competitor** — `prediction_aggregator.py:135-138` + `ai_predictor.py:80` — **[CONFIRMED]**
Uncached; called in `get_all_predictions` then again in `predict_competitor_time_with_ai`. **Fix:** memoize (lru_cache / path+mtime), or load once and pass in.

**Every base ML prediction re-engineers the full dataset** — `ml_model.py:671` — **[CONFIRMED]**
`predict_time_ml` re-runs `engineer_features_for_ml(results_df, wood_df)` per competitor (groupby/apply/polyfit over the whole table) inside the calibration block. **Fix:** cache the engineered frame keyed by results-table size, as the models already do.

### Low

- **Monte Carlo hardcoded to 10M simulations, docstrings say 2M** — `championship_simulator.py:230` — a blocking single-threaded 10M run for a view-only tool, 5× documented. **Fix:** reduce to `2_000_000` / `sim_config.NUM_SIMULATIONS` and reconcile docstrings.
- **`estimate_competitor_std_dev` recomputed from the full frame per competitor** — `strathmark_adapter.py:231-238` — O(competitors × rows). **Fix:** one groupby, look up in the loop.
- **Massive LLM prompt built even when Ollama is known-down** — `ai_predictor.py:207-416` — per-competitor `iterrows` + ~170-line f-string discarded when `call_ollama` short-circuits. **Fix:** check `_ollama_status` before building; build `wood_data_text` once per run.
- **Scaling exponent recomputed inside a per-row `apply`** — `baseline.py:258-268` — memoized so cheap, plus a discarded `row.get('species')`. **Fix:** hoist the constant; delete the dead read.
- **`get_species_name_from_code` re-reads the whole wood sheet on each unknown-code miss** — `excel_io.py:222-250` — no "fully loaded" flag. **Fix:** set a loaded flag after the first full read.
- **Results reloaded inside the per-competitor add-times loop** — `competitor_ui.py:70-77` — every in-loop reload is overwritten; only the last survives. **Fix:** reload once after the loop.
- **Excel re-read 3-5×/session + in-loop re-import** — `championship_simulator.py:100-133, 1173-1175, 1214` — **Fix:** load once *before* era normalization (PB/transferability need the pre-norm copy) and thread it through; drop the in-loop imports.
- **Redundant repeated `pd.to_datetime` of the same column** — `preprocessing.py:90, 276, 312` — no-op on an already-datetime column; clarity, not speed. **Fix:** coerce once at load.
- **Hardcoded `+/- 3s` variance text + missing thousands separator** — `visualization.py:51` — **Fix:** derive from config; `{:,}`.

## 6. Architecture

### Medium

**`MainProgramV5_2.py` runs all startup side effects and the interactive loop at import time (no `__main__` guard)** — `MainProgramV5_2.py:16-24, 108-189, 1869-1987` — **[CONFIRMED]**
No `if __name__ == "__main__":`. Importing the module spawns a shell (`chcp`), sleeps, prints the banner, loads competitors + results Excel, mutates the persistent ResultStore, then blocks on `input()` forever. Untestable/unreusable via import. **Fix:** move init + migration + the `while True:` loop into a `main()` under a `__main__` guard; pass `tournament_state`/`wood_selection` explicitly instead of reassigning module globals.

### Low

- **Import-time `sys.path.insert` scattered across modules** — `excel_io.py:14`, `preprocessing.py:12`, `validation.py:11`, `competitor_dashboard.py:17` — repeated global `sys.path` mutation solely to import top-level `config`; brittle to directory depth, can shadow top-level modules. **Fix:** make `config` importable as part of the package (or a single entrypoint/conftest shim); drop the per-module inserts.
- **Redundant in-function re-imports obscure the dependency graph** — `baseline.py:1730, 1838-1839, 1174, 1731-1735`; `MainProgram:806`; `bracket_ui.py:541-545`; `v52_helpers.py:454-457`; `prediction_aggregator.py:135` — `config.baseline_v2_config` and `woodchopping.data` symbols are already imported at module top (line 20 proves **no** circular cycle exists). These are gratuitous, not cycle-avoidance. **Fix:** hoist the no-cycle ones to module scope; keep only genuine cycle-breakers.
- **`_species_cache` never invalidated despite write paths mutating the Wood sheet** — `excel_io.py:207` — stale species names after a wood edit. **Fix:** add a cache-clear hook invoked on workbook writes. *(Overlaps with the negative-cache finding in §2.)*
- **Throwaway `type('obj',(object,),{...})()` to pass one flag** — `prediction_aggregator.py:278-283, 316-322` — anonymous class+instance just to hand `adjust_confidence_for_scaling` one string attribute; brittle coupling to that attribute name. **Fix:** pass the flag/string directly (or a `SimpleNamespace`).
- **Analytics coupled to Excel Title-Case columns via an inverse rename** — `competitor_profiling.py:35,48,51,58,81` + `competitor_dashboard.py:101-111` — the analytics module indexes Title-Case columns; the sole caller renames snake_case back to Title-Case first, so any direct `load_results_df` caller hits KeyError and two rename tables must stay in sync. **Fix:** standardize analytics on the snake_case schema; delete the inverse rename.
- **`config` event-code helpers crash on `None`** — `config.py:505-524` — `event_code.upper()` with no guard → AttributeError instead of `False`/clean ValueError; `wood_selection.get('event')` can be `None`. **Fix:** guard falsy/non-str at the top of both helpers.
- **Inconsistent `entry_fees_paid` access** — `entry_fee_tracker.py:48,308 (read) vs 175,244 (write)` — **[PLAUSIBLE]** — reads use `.get`, writes index directly; init guarantees make a crash unlikely. **Fix:** `setdefault('entry_fees_paid', {})[event_id] = True`.

## Bigger refactors
*(higher effort, needs care / test coverage)*

1. **Delete the seven orphaned prediction modules + their tests** (`production`, `stacking_ensemble`, `lightgbm_model`, `randomforest_model`, `ridge_model`, `calibration`, `diameter_diagnostic`) — ~2,000 lines, resolves a whole cluster of dead-but-real model bugs and duplication. Verify strathmark doesn't re-import them first. *(§3)*
2. **Unify the Results-sheet schema** — one column definition in `excel_io`, one writer; delete the `handicap_ui` duplicate and the auto-create path's divergent order; migrate the live file for Round/HeatID. Removes the NaT/NaN/misalignment corruption class at its root. *(§1/§4)*
3. **Fix cache invalidation** — have `invalidate_baseline_v2_cache` clear `_wood_hardness_cache`/`_species_exponent_cache`/`_event_exponent_cache` (or key them on a data fingerprint), and add a wood/species cache-clear hook on workbook writes. Prevents stale calibration + cross-test contamination. *(§2/§6)*
4. **Add `main()` + `__name__` guard to `MainProgramV5_2.py`** and stop reassigning module globals — makes the app importable/testable. *(§6)*
5. **Consolidate the V1 baseline fallback** into one parameterized helper (the two copies have already drifted their size defaults) and extract the shared mask/quality/pairwise-diff helpers so NaN guards and thresholds live in one place. *(§4)*
6. **Introduce a shared workbook-open + memoized-load layer** with explicit write-path invalidation, and thread `wood_df`/results through the per-competitor loops (`get_all_predictions`, add-times, event assignment). Eliminates the repeated-Excel-read family in one pass. *(§5)*
7. **Sync all four competitor structures on scratch/restore** (`all_competitors`, `all_competitors_df`, `handicap_results_all`, round `competitors_df`) with status guards — closes the withdrawn-competitor-reappears integrity gap. *(§1/§2)*
